date_note: The article gives no earlier day than its publication day; it says the outage hit on Monday 23 November.
exec: A hospital IT outage disrupted emergency care; the hospital says nothing currently points to a cyberattack.
geo_basis: country as stated; the page names the hospital, not a city
impact: Long emergency waits and SAMU redirected to other hospitals, per L'essentiel.
plain: A computer outage hit a hospital in northern Luxembourg. The hospital told L'essentiel nothing points to a cyberattack for now; a technical fault is the favoured explanation.
summary: A computer outage hit the Centre hospitalier du Nord (CHdN) in Luxembourg on 23 November, and L'essentiel says the hospital was heavily affected. The hospital told the paper "Rien n'indique pour le moment une cyberattaque" while service was being restored. L'essentiel reports a technical problem with the fibres linking servers as the favoured explanation, with long emergency waits and the SAMU redirected to other hospitals.
title: Computer outage at Luxembourg's CHdN hospital; hospital says nothing points to a cyberattack

validation.note: Single publisher (L'essentiel); the hospital's statement is relayed by it, no hospital page read.
